# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class FutureContractRollingAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Create the SPX Future symbol.
        self._symbol = Symbol.create_future("SPX")
        # Set the data normalization mode as raw for accuracy in filtering.
        self._symbol.data_normalization_mode = DataNormalizationMode.RAW
        # You can also create the symbol with the market hours of the underlying index.
        # self._symbol = Symbol.future("SPX", Market.USA())
        # Add the FOP price dataset for daily SPX Future data.
        self.add_future(self._symbol, FOPPriceDataset)
        # Set the minimum time in universe to filter the expired contracts.
        self.universe_settings.minimum_time_in_universe = timedelta(hours=1)
        # Create EMA indicators for trend detection.
        self._price_ema = ExponentialMovingAverage(10)
        self._volume_ema = ExponentialMovingAverage(10)
        # Warm up for immediate usage of indicators.
        self.set_warm_up(2, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        # Get the current contract and its price.
        contract = slice.get_contract(self._symbol)
        if not contract:
            return
        # Skip if market is closed to avoid invalid indicator values.
        if not self.is_market_open(self._symbol):
            return
        # Update indicators with the current bar data.
        bar = slice.bars.get(self._symbol)
        if not bar:
            return
        self._price_ema.update(bar.close)
        self._volume_ema.update(bar.volume)
        # Check if the current contract has expired to avoid trading invalid contracts.
        if contract.expiry < self.time + timedelta(1):
            self.liquidate(self._symbol, "Expired contract")
            return
        # Buy if price EMA is above volume EMA.
        if not self._symbol.invested and self._price_ema.current.value > self._volume_ema.current.value:
            self.set_holdings(self._symbol, 1)
        # Sell if price EMA is below volume EMA.
        elif self._symbol.invested and self._price_ema.current.value < self._volume_ema.current.value:
            self.liquidate(self._symbol, "Price EMA below volume EMA")
